setlist_extra.title: This Could Be the Last Time

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (3 reviews): Returned to the setlist after 19 years away, played in the Sonoran desert; Rough band harmonies, with Jerry's vocals sounding soulful, weathered and unpolished [14][16][24]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): Hot version, with strong keyboard work from Vince [19]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): An ultralight plane swooped over the crowd during it, explaining Bob's Texas dragonfly comment [22]
- **Me & My Uncle** (1 review): Bobby fumbles lyrics on this one [19]
- **Maggie's Farm** (1 review): Me & My Uncle into Maggie's Farm is messy, with Weir all over the place [24]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Uncle John's Band through Playin', Drums and into The Last Time is called the heart of the show [17]
- **Playin' In The Band Reprise** (1 review): The Playin' reprise runs about nine minutes [24]
- **The Last Time** (1 review): The Space into The Last Time sounds war-like and a little frightening [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Here Comes Sunshine**: back after 1309 archived shows (6861 days) [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-12-06.125410.schoeps441.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 159 min [1]
- **gd92-12-06.sbd.wiley.8706.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 145 min; rated 4.29/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: The soundboard is clean with a very good mix, and Weir's grungy guitar tone stays prominent all show; Bobby's guitar is high in the mix throughout, especially good on Althea; Very good recording, though some stage tech was rough, with microphones often cutting in late [16][17][21]
- **gd1992-12-06.mtx.hansokolow.97819.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 161 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1992-12-06.165886.sbd.miller.flac2448**: soundboard; 19 songs; 156 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1992-12-06.schoeps.evans.gems.33956.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [10]

## Around the show

- Band seemed highly charged, coming off a cancelled fall tour [17]
- Arizona was wet and flooded before the show, then the sun came out Saturday morning [20]
- Reviewer's group parked in an adjoining field for Sunday and got badly stuck in mud [20]
- Here Comes Sunshine was soundchecked the previous day, so it was not a total surprise [21]
- An ultralight buzzed the stage during set one, prompting the Texas dragonfly remark after Friend Of The Devil [21]
- Drive went through a blizzard in northern Arizona, arriving at an 80-degree day in Tempe [22]
- During intermission a man on stilts in a long orange dress walked through the crowd [22]
- Reviewer drove from Flagstaff's nasty weather down to sunshine at the Compton Terrace in Chandler [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-12-06.125410.schoeps441.flac16**: source: Shoeps 441 > DAT > CM [1]
- **gd92-12-06.sbd.wiley.8706.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1992-12-06.mtx.hansokolow.97819.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of DSBD: shnid=94107 and DAUD: shnid=33956 by hansokolow using ProTools [3]. Also: Matrix made by hansokolow in ProTools from digital sources, with transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller; Chain: Sony R500 DAT, Sound Devices 744T, Samplitude, FLAC; mics were Schoeps CMC32 split omnis; Uses shnid 8706 as a patch, pitch adjusted by 1.5 semitones [3]
- **gd1992-12-06.165886.sbd.miller.flac2448**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 30, 2023; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: This source is unedited and complete, covering tape flips that the circulating DAT soundboard edits between songs [4]
- **gd1992-12-06.schoeps.evans.gems.33956.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans; transferred by **_**; source: Schoeps CMC32 Split Omnis -> Monster M1000 Jumpers -> -> Oade Pre -> MonsterM1000 Cable -> 7ft Stand -> Panasonic sv255 [10]. Also: Master DAT played on a TASCAM DA-20, via M-Audio FireWire Solo into Soundforge 8.0 [10]
